title: Budget the measured evaluation lifecycle, and label extrapolations as forecasts
claim: The retained Ascend v3 headroom run executed 2,650 of 4,768 scheduled calls and charged 1,440.294565 CPU seconds; 43.190720 CPU minutes is a proportional full-schedule forecast, not a proven minimum or additional measured spend.

conditions.workload: Random, greedy and short simulated annealing eight seeds each plus declared four long-SA reference runs; worker deliberately reaped after each evaluation for SELF+CHILDREN accounting.

objective_metric.name: Completed scheduled evaluations and CPU/wall lifecycle charge

comparator_intervention.comparison: Recorded partial execution vs declared full schedule; observed average multiplied by full call count

reported_effect.forecast_kind: Proportional extrapolation of observed implementation/call mix

independent_verification_scope.retained_review: Frozen numerical-forensics analysis rechecked original runner/prereg hashes and retained arithmetic; source records do not retain every native input/output and proposal trajectory.
independent_verification_scope.curator: Exact-byte and quotation checks only, with no new workload, timing measurement or forecast fit.

architect_usefulness.decision: Measure startup, generation, solve, teardown/reap, archival and failure cleanup before committing a scientific schedule.
architect_usefulness.recommended_design: Persist actual resource debits separately from forecasts and reserve, bind resource feasibility to the deployed evaluator lifecycle, and keep incomplete-reference acceptance distinct from a promising numeric gap.
architect_usefulness.transfer_limit: This call mix and implementation do not establish a universal CPU floor or a measured speedup available from a different design.

sources.quote: The run completed 2,650 of 4,768 scheduled calls;
using **1,525.852038 wall seconds and 1,440.294565 CPU seconds**.
The implementation deliberately reaped the worker after each evaluation so that CHILDREN CPU, including worker startup, would be visible alongside SELF CPU at the next admission check.
The observed whole-run average was 0.543507383 CPU seconds per call; completing 4,768 calls in 1,440 seconds requires 0.302013423 seconds per call before adding any unaccounted reserve.
Multiplying the observed average by the full call count gives **2,591.443202 CPU seconds, or 43.190720 minutes**.
This is a proportional forecast from this implementation and call mix, not measured extra consumption, a worst-case bound, or a request to increase the allowance.

title: A lower retained thermal objective can accompany a worse interconnect proxy
claim: The lowest-temperature retained Ascend v3 layout increases the frozen weighted Manhattan centre-distance proxy from 27.69934640522876 to 40.529411764705884 mm (+46.319%). Its promising thermal screen does not demonstrate fixed-wire improvement or an agent advantage.

conditions.workload: One fixed-power scenario; long-SA screen vs cheap-method medians, with reference incomplete.

objective_metric.thermal: Maximum active-chip layer-4 cell temperature at grid32
objective_metric.wire: Normalized weighted Manhattan distance between chiplet centres using frozen connectivity

comparator_intervention.wire_comparator: Saved best vs original initial layout
comparator_intervention.thermal_comparator: Best cheap-method median 117.685 C vs retained long-SA best 116.09 C

independent_verification_scope.retained_review: Original source review found all 26 nonempty retained winners geometrically legal; numerical forensics recomputed the proxy and checked retained summary identities. Fresh long-SA reproduction and full native trajectories are absent.
independent_verification_scope.curator: Rehashes frozen diagnosis/forensics and binds exact quotations; no new search, geometry solve or reproduction.

architect_usefulness.decision: Keep geometric legality, objective value, interconnect cost and scientific acceptance as separate facts.
architect_usefulness.recommended_design: If fixed-initial-wire is the intended task, freeze that constraint prospectively and optimize within it; expose wire/thermal tradeoffs without relabeling a distance proxy as routed wire.
architect_usefulness.transfer_limit: Increased separation is a plausible mechanism, not an isolated measured cause; post-filtering saved winners cannot reconstruct a constrained search that was never performed.

has **W = 40.529411764705884 mm**, a **46.319% increase**; 25 of 26 saved winners exceed the initial value.
It is a useful proxy, not routed wirelength, signal timing, congestion, power-delivery quality or a package reliability check.
